sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Enlarged tonsils are filled with little
crypts.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Chronic cough ; hectic fever ; green,
purulent expectoration. Croup. Pneumonia.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Indolent ulcers, accompanying varicose veins.
Easy perspiration.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Agraphis — Bluebell (ade-
noids with enlarged tonsils). Here Sulpli. iod. follows
both Agraphis and Calc. iod. Aeon, lycotonum (swell-
ing of glands, Hodgkin’s disease).

Compare also: Calc, fluor.; Sil.; Merc. iod.
